objects.name: CrowdStrike Delivers the Next Evolution of the Agentic SOC
objects.description: After more than three decades in federal technology and cybersecurity, David Mihelcic joins AttackIQ as Federal Field CTO. He shares why continuous validation and Adversarial Exposure Validation are increasingly essential to defending federal networks against evolving threats. The post Why I Chose to Join AttackIQ as Federal Field CTO — and What Federal Cyber Defense Needs Next appeared first on AttackIQ .
